material.description: OpenStax Biology 2e, §§4.2–4.3 “Prokaryotic Cells” and “Eukaryotic Cells” (https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/4-2-prokaryotic-cells; https://openstax.org/books/biology-2e/pages/4-3-eukaryotic-cells): §4.2 states that prokaryotes lack a nucleus or other membrane-bound organelles; §4.3 states that eukaryotic cells have a membrane-bound nucleus. This directly supports the stated distinction without generalizing other cellular features.
